scripts.generate-contract: node scripts/generate-contract.mjs && json2ts -i src/generated/catalogue-dataset-schema.json -o src/generated/catalogue-dataset.ts --bannerComment '/* Generated from the Pydantic Catalogue Dataset serialization schema. Do not edit. */'
